historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case organic path (FY2027-31 average ~5.2%), not equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 9.1% vs revenue 6.7% (+36%) and EPS 2.0%: book equity compounds from retained earnings recycled into debt-funded M&A (Olink, Solventum P&F, Clario), not from per-share earnings growth. Equity CAGR is rejected as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: All 3- and 5-year windows start in the COVID testing windfall (FY2020-22) and end after the FY2023-24 destocking trough, so trailing CAGRs understate the business; 10-year revenue CAGR (10.1%) is inflated by Life Technologies/PPD/Patheon M&A. Owner-FCF CAGR (-3.2% 3yr) is only slightly below reported FCF CAGR (-3.1%): SBC is ~0.7% of revenue and is not the story here.

scenario_narratives.base: The post-COVID destocking and biotech-funding slump has bottomed: Q2 2026 organic growth of 5% and the raised guide ($47.4-48.1B revenue, ~4% organic) mark the turn. Pharma/biotech grows mid-single digits, academic/government returns to low-single digits as NIH uncertainty resolves, and bioproduction (now including Solventum purification & filtration) normalises. Organic growth settles at 5-5.5% -- respectable for a $48B business but short of the 7-9% the company aspires to -- while PPI and acquisition synergies add ~30bp/yr of margin against a persistent tariff drag. Clario (clinical-trial endpoint data) and Olink add mix but are paid for (Clario's $8.9B sits in net debt).
scenario_narratives.bull: The recovery becomes a re-acceleration: biotech funding recovers fully, large-molecule and GLP-1 manufacturing drive bioprocessing consumables and Patheon CDMO capacity, Olink makes proteomics a real platform, and pharma outsourcing lifts the CRO business. Organic growth reaches 7% for several years, scale and bundling hold pricing, and PPI expands EBITDA margin to 27.5%. This is the sell-side ($730-780 targets) story -- it needs bioprocessing, academic funding AND China to cooperate at once.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 recovery proves a restocking blip. US NIH appropriations are cut or sequestered, small-biotech funding dries up again, China's localisation policy and US-China tariffs erode the ~7.5% China book and add cost, and competition in bioprocessing and instruments (Danaher/Cytiva, Sartorius, Agilent, Waters) caps pricing. Organic growth runs 2.5-3.5% and margins slip ~70bp; with net debt at ~3.3x EBITDA after Clario, capital that would have gone to buybacks goes to deleveraging. The business remains highly cash-generative -- this is a de-rating case, not a solvency case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on unlevered component flows with SBC fully expensed and the share count held flat. Growth is organic plus already-closed deals; TMO's historical M&A-driven compounding is deliberately not capitalised because the cash it would cost is not in the flows. The FY2023-24 trough is a revenue/volume trough, not a margin trough, so no mid-cycle uplift is applied.
key_risks_to_valuation: Terminal value is ~60-65% of EV and the 20x cap binds at any WACC at or below 8%: +1pp WACC takes base value from ~$362 to ~$290 (-20%); the price is only reached with an exit multiple well above 20x owner FCF
Excluding future M&A understates value if TMO keeps buying growth at returns above WACC (its record suggests it has), and overstates it if it overpays
Biotech funding / NIH budget cyclicality drives instrument and bioproduction volumes
China (~7.5% of revenue) localisation and tariffs; ~80bp adjusted margin headwind flagged in early 2026
Leverage ~3.3x net debt/EBITDA after Clario limits buybacks if a downturn coincides with refinancing

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular close); 52-week range 435.27-683.63
data_sources.financials: TMO_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL, FY2007-Q2 2026); component lines (depreciation, amortisation, cash taxes, interest, diluted shares, debt split, leases, acquisitions) from SEC XBRL companyfacts CIK 0000097745
data_sources.qualitative: TMO_Analysis.json (2026-10-02): Q2 2026 results and raised FY2026 guidance, Solventum P&F and Olink acquisitions, China ~7.5%

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash flow statement ShareBasedCompensation add-back $310M (SEC XBRL companyfacts). TMO does not tag a separate tax-withholding-on-net-share-settlement line; it sits inside immaterial 'other financing' and is not added (immaterial vs a $6.3B FCF base).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases $3.0B (financing outflow, not authorisation); H1 2026 $4.0B. Active repurchaser: the flat share count is funded, ~8-10x the SBC charge.
inputs.share_count_basis: 371.0M weighted-average diluted shares, Q2 2026 10-Q (quarter ended 2026-06-27). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; buybacks are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: 31 December (52/53-week quarters closing on a Saturday)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Rf 4.2% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%, beta ~0.9 -> cost of equity ~8.7%; pre-tax cost of debt ~4.6% (interest expense $1.42B on ~$38B average debt FY2025) -> ~3.6% after tax; D/(D+E) ~14% at market (net debt $38.5B vs ~$242B equity). WACC ~8.0%. No ad-hoc premium for cyclicality or M&A risk: that risk is charged once, through the bear scenario and its 20% weight. Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: lease cost ($381M FY2025) is an operating expense already inside EBITDA, and the $1.47B operating-lease liability is NOT added to net debt. One treatment, charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Noncontrolling interest is $7M (2026-06-27) -- immaterial, ignored. Equity-method investments $178M (FY2025) -- immaterial, not added.
inputs.net_debt_note: Total debt = LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations $39,181M (noncurrent) + DebtCurrent $3,368M = $42,549M at 2026-06-27 (no double count of current maturities; ties to CSV Q2 2026). Cash $4,064M; short-term investments $0. Net debt $38,485M includes the ~$8.9B debt-funded Clario acquisition (paid Q1 2026), whose revenue enters FY2026 growth -- the cost and the revenue are both in the model.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income ($993M FY2025, $440M H1 2026) is NOT deducted: TMO is net-debt, and the component build is unlevered (EBITDA-based, before interest income and expense), with net debt deducted at the bridge.
inputs.component_anchor_fy2025: Revenue $44,556M; GAAP operating income $7,746M; depreciation $1,050M + intangible amortisation $1,730M = D&A $2,780M (6.2%); SBC $310M (0.70%); GAAP EBITDA pre-SBC $10,836M (24.3%). Adjusted operating margin (company basis, ex amortisation/restructuring) ~22.7% implies ~25.8% pre-SBC EBITDA; restructuring recurs every year at TMO so FY0 is set at 24.5%, between the two. Cash taxes $1,776M / GAAP EBIT $7,746M = 22.9% (FY2023 21.6%, FY2024 25.0%). Capex $1,525M (3.4%); H1 2026 3.6%. Engine FY0 owner FCF margin ~15.8% vs FY2024 actual unlevered owner FCF ~17.1% and FY2025 ~14.6% (FY2025 OCF carried working-capital and tax-timing drag).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF (component route, 10-year horizon), per .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md routing row 'Operating company'. TMO is a US life-sciences tools/consumables/CDMO-CRO operator with free cash flow as its value stream -- not a bank/REIT/holdco. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry, no prior DCF). Mid-cycle check: FY2023-24 was a revenue/FCF trough after post-COVID destocking, but MARGINS are not at a trough -- GAAP operating margin 17.4% FY2025 vs 18.0% FY2019 pre-COVID and the COVID-windfall 24-26% FY2020-21. FY2025/26 is therefore treated as approximately mid-cycle: no trough uplift and no COVID-peak haircut is needed; FY2020-22 are excluded from any margin anchor. Growth is modelled ORGANIC-plus-closed-deals only (Solventum P&F and Clario are in the FY2026 guide); future M&A is not modelled because its purchase price is not in the flows. FY2026 year-1 growth anchored to the raised guide ($47.4-48.1B, midpoint +7.2%). Price is the regular close. Band position is reported as >1000% because the price sits far ABOVE the street (SBC-as-non-cash) value as well as the house value: SBC is only ~0.7% of revenue, so the house/street band is narrow (~$20/share) and the gap to the price is a discount-rate/exit-multiple gap, not an SBC-treatment gap. Required-return table: the price of 652.51 is above even the 6% WACC sensitivity cell, i.e. the market is capitalising TMO at well over 20x terminal owner FCF, or is pricing continued value-accretive M&A that this model excludes.
inputs.terminal_rationale: Terminal value = min(Gordon, cap). Base/bull cap 20x terminal owner FCF (~12.7x EBITDA) for a mature, consumables-heavy market leader; Gordon at 8.0%/3.0% is 20.6x, so the cap binds marginally. Bear cap 18x and g 2.5% (Gordon 18.7x, so the 18x cap binds marginally). TMO has historically traded at 18-25x EBITDA, so these exits assume a material de-rating toward a no-M&A, mid-single-digit-growth business.

bear.rationale: Below the bottom of the guide (H2 slows after the 8.4% H1), then a second biotech-funding/NIH leg down and China localisation hold organic growth at 2.5-3.5%; tariff costs and pricing pressure from Danaher/Sartorius/Waters in bioprocessing take ~70bp off EBITDA margin; Pillar Two / OBBBA lift cash tax.

base.rationale: Year 1 = FY2026 guide midpoint ($47.75B, incl. Solventum P&F full year and Clario from Q1). Then organic recovery from ~4% (2026) to 5-5.5% as bioproduction normalises and academic/government stabilises -- below management's 7-9% LT organic aspiration, above the 2026 run-rate -- fading to 3% by year 10. EBITDA margin +30bp/yr (PPI, Solventum/Clario synergies, mix toward consumables) against tariff drag, plateauing at 26%. D&A tapers to capex by year 10 so the acquired-intangible amortisation tax shield is not perpetuated. Working capital consumes 10% of incremental revenue (receivables + inventory > payables).

bull.rationale: Top of the FY2026 guide, then organic growth reaches the 7% lower end of management's LT target for four years on bioprocessing, Olink proteomics and CDMO/CRO outsourcing; PPI margin expansion of ~50bp/yr to 27.5%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default): end-markets have whipsawed twice in five years, NIH and China/tariff policy are live, and leverage is elevated after the Clario/Solventum deals. Base 50%: the raised guide and Q2 beat are hard evidence the trough has passed. Bull 30% (below the 35% default): it needs bioprocessing, academic funding and China to all go right at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
